title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計
summary: 以一台 DN100、約 260 L/s 的混合軸承渦輪分子泵與它的泵站為對象：從分子流下葉片把動量傳給氣體分子出發，理解壓縮比為何隨分子量呈指數變化、前級壓力如何決定極限壓力；再把轉子材料與動平衡、電容薄膜計、Pirani、Penning 與 Bayard–Alpert 真空計的物理與校正鏈、抽速量測與互鎖整合成可驗收的真空泵站。
summaryEn: Built around a DN100, roughly 260 L/s hybrid-bearing turbomolecular pump and its pumping station: start from blades handing momentum to gas molecules in molecular flow to see why the compression ratio grows exponentially with molecular mass and how foreline pressure sets the ultimate pressure, then integrate rotor materials and balancing, the physics and calibration chain of capacitance-diaphragm, Pirani, Penning and Bayard–Alpert gauges, pumping-speed measurement and interlocks into a pumping station that can be accepted.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 泵站選型練習：一台 50 L 的分析腔（例如飛行時間質譜儀）有樣品進氣負載 Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s，另加出氣 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s，目標工作壓力 1×10⁻⁶ mbar。所需有效抽速 S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s。泵接在 DN100、20 cm 的管上，C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s，所需泵抽速 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835，S_pump ≈ 120 L/s；選一台 260 L/s 的 DN100 泵留餘裕：S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s，工作壓力 p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar，達標且有近兩倍餘裕。前級：流量 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s 在 1×10⁻² mbar 的前級壓力下只需 0.01 L/s 的前級抽速，小型隔膜泵綽綽有餘；氫回流 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 可忽略。真空計：Pirani 在 10⁻³ mbar 切換到 BA 計，BA 計靈敏度 20 mbar⁻¹、發射 1 mA，在 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar 的離子電流為 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA，遠高於 X 光極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Pump-station sizing exercise: a 50 L analytical chamber (for example a time-of-flight mass spectrometer) has a sample-inlet load Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s plus 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s of outgassing and a target working pressure of 1×10⁻⁶ mbar. The required effective speed is S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s. With the pump on a DN100 tube 20 cm long, C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s, the required pump speed follows from 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835, S_pump ≈ 120 L/s; choosing a 260 L/s DN100 pump for margin gives S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s and a working pressure p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar, meeting the target with nearly a factor of two in hand. Backing: a throughput of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s at a foreline pressure of 1×10⁻² mbar needs only 0.01 L/s of backing speed, so a small diaphragm pump is ample, and the hydrogen backflow 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar is negligible. Gauges: the Pirani hands over to the BA gauge at 10⁻³ mbar, and with a sensitivity of 20 mbar⁻¹ and 1 mA emission the ion current at 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar is 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA, far above the X-ray limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」與「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" and "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「轉子葉片與氣體分子」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor blades and gas molecules” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。因為 c̄ 隨 1/√M 增加，氫分子比氮快 3.7 倍，同一組葉片對氫的「追得上」程度差很多，壓縮比隨 √M 呈指數變化。入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. Because c̄ grows as 1/√M, hydrogen moves 3.7 times faster than nitrogen, the blades keep up with it far less well, and the compression ratio therefore varies exponentially with √M. The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotor blades and gas molecules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Rotor blades and gas molecules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotor blades and gas molecules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。氮在 293 K 的 c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s，兩者相當；氫的 c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s，v/c̄ 只有 0.27。壓縮比寫成 K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M)：若純渦輪級對氮 K₀ = 10⁸，則 a·√28 = 18.4，a ≈ 3.48，對氫 K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140（教學估算；實際混合泵靠 Holweck 段把氫壓縮比拉到 10³–10⁵）。入口抽速上限 S ≈ 11.6·A·α，DN100 入口 A ≈ 78.5 cm²，捕獲機率 α ≈ 0.3，S ≈ 273 L/s，與 DN100 泵約 260 L/s 的標稱值相符。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s. Nitrogen at 293 K has c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s, a match; hydrogen has c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s, so v/c̄ is only 0.27. Writing K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M): if pure turbo stages give K₀ = 10⁸ for nitrogen then a·√28 = 18.4, a ≈ 3.48 and K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140 for hydrogen (teaching estimate; real hybrid pumps use Holweck stages to lift hydrogen compression to 10³–10⁵). The inlet speed limit S ≈ 11.6·A·α with A ≈ 78.5 cm² for DN100 and capture probability α ≈ 0.3 gives S ≈ 273 L/s, consistent with the roughly 260 L/s nameplate of a DN100 pump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「轉子葉片與氣體分子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Rotor blades and gas molecules” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。把量到的 K₀(N₂)、K₀(He)、K₀(H₂) 對 √M 作半對數圖，應近似一條直線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent. Plotting the measured K₀ for N₂, He and H₂ against √M on a semi-log scale should give roughly a straight line. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「前級管路與 Holweck 段」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foreline and Holweck stage” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。零流量壓縮比 K₀ 決定每種氣體從前級回流到入口的分壓，入口極限壓力是各氣體 p_fore,i/K₀,i 的總和再加上出氣量除以抽速；重氣體的 K₀ 高達 10¹¹，前級成分只對氫與氦重要。高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing. The zero-flow compression ratio K₀ sets the partial pressure of each gas that leaks back from foreline to inlet, and the inlet ultimate pressure is the sum of p_fore,i/K₀,i over the gases plus outgassing divided by pumping speed; for heavy gases K₀ reaches 10¹¹, so the foreline composition matters only for hydrogen and helium. At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Foreline and Holweck stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。前級總壓 5×10⁻² mbar（渦卷泵），其中氫分壓 1×10⁻⁴ mbar（教學假設）。氮：5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar，可忽略。氫：混合泵 K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ 時為 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar；舊式純渦輪泵 K₀(H₂) = 10³ 時為 1×10⁻⁷ mbar。若腔體氫出氣 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s、S = 260 L/s，出氣項為 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar，比氫回流項小得多，所以這台泵站的下限由前級氫分壓與 K₀(H₂) 決定，而不是由泵的抽速決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Hydrogen: with a hybrid pump of K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ it is 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar; with an older pure turbo pump of K₀(H₂) = 10³ it is 1×10⁻⁷ mbar. If chamber hydrogen outgassing is Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and S = 260 L/s, the outgassing term is 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar, far below the hydrogen backflow term, so this station's floor is set by foreline hydrogen and K₀(H₂), not by the pump's speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉子由單塊高強度鋁合金整體切削，葉尖速度 300–500 m/s 使離心應力逼近材料極限，所以轉子溫度上限（約 90–120 °C）是為了控制鋁合金的潛變而設。轉子必須做到極高等級的動平衡，否則不平衡力隨 ω² 放大成振動與軸承負載。軸承有兩種：混合軸承在前級側用陶瓷球加鋼製滾道、終身潤滑油脂，在高真空側用永磁軸承；五軸主動磁浮則完全沒有潤滑劑與微粒、振動更低，但需要備用的機械落地軸承承受斷電或撞機。葉片的製造公差、表面處理與入口防護網都屬於轉子工程的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The rotor is machined from a single block of high-strength aluminium alloy, and tip speeds of 300–500 m/s push the centrifugal stress toward the material limit, which is why the rotor temperature ceiling of about 90–120 °C exists: it bounds the creep of the alloy. The rotor must be balanced to an extremely fine grade, because any residual unbalance is amplified by ω² into vibration and bearing load. Two bearing systems are used: hybrid bearings with ceramic balls on steel races and lifetime grease on the foreline side plus a permanent-magnet bearing on the high-vacuum side, or five-axis active magnetic levitation with no lubricant and no particles and lower vibration, which needs backup touchdown bearings for power loss or a crash. Blade machining tolerances, surface treatment and the inlet protection screen are all part of rotor engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋁合金轉子與軸承」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：實心圓盤的最大離心應力 σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip²（ν = 0.3）：鋁合金 ρ = 2700 kg/m³、v_tip = 471 m/s，σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa，對降伏強度約 500 MPa 的 7000 系鋁合金安全係數約 2。平衡等級 G 0.4 代表 e·ω = 0.4 mm/s：ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s，重心偏心 e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm。轉子動能 E = ½·I·ω²，取 I = 1.6×10⁻³ kg·m²，E ≈ 0.5×1.6×10⁻³×9425² ≈ 71 kJ，撞機時這些能量在毫秒內釋放成法蘭上的扭矩，所以安裝螺栓數與法蘭等級必須依廠商規定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

Balance grade G 0.4 means e·ω = 0.4 mm/s: with ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s the centre-of-mass eccentricity is e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm. steps.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotor materials, balancing and bearings: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鋁合金轉子與軸承」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在泵的法蘭上用加速規量振動頻譜：基頻在轉速頻率（90,000 rpm 即 1500 Hz）及其諧波，軸承缺陷頻率另有特徵線；每季記錄振幅趨勢，上升代表軸承磨耗或不平衡變化。記錄升速與自然減速時間、軸承溫度；磁浮泵則監看位置感測器的軌跡振幅。把這些數值和廠商驗收值比較，超過即安排軸承保養。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the vibration spectrum on the pump flange with an accelerometer: the fundamental sits at the rotation frequency (90,000 rpm is 1500 Hz) with its harmonics, and bearing-defect frequencies show up as separate lines; log the amplitude trend quarterly, and a rise indicates bearing wear or a change in balance. Record run-up and free run-down times and bearing temperature; on a magnetically levitated pump watch the orbit amplitude from the position sensors. Compare these with the vendor's acceptance values and schedule bearing service when exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一顆螺絲掉進入口，或空氣在全速時從入口灌入：轉子撞機，葉片剪斷、71 kJ 動能在毫秒內變成扭矩；若泵只用了幾顆螺栓固定、沒有依規定安裝，泵會從法蘭上扭脫並損壞腔體；後果是泵報廢、腔體檢修，所以入口網與受控通氣閥不是選配。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A screw dropped into the inlet, or air rushing in through the inlet at full speed, crashes the rotor: blades shear and 71 kJ of kinetic energy becomes torque within milliseconds; if the pump was held by only a few bolts outside the vendor's mounting rules it twists off the flange and damages the chamber; the consequence is a scrapped pump and a chamber overhaul, which is why the inlet screen and the controlled vent valve are not optional.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.objective: 說明「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沒有任何一種真空計能從 1000 mbar 量到 10⁻¹² mbar，所以泵站要用三種物理機制接力：電容薄膜計直接量氣體對薄膜的力，與氣體種類無關，每個感測頭涵蓋約四個數量級，精度可達 0.2%；Pirani 計量加熱絲的熱損失，在 10⁻⁴ 到 10 mbar 之間熱損失與壓力有關，但隨氣體的熱傳導係數不同而讀值不同，接近大氣時熱傳導不再隨壓力變化而飽和；游離計分成冷陰極的 Penning／反磁控管（放電電流約隨 p^n 變化，n 約 1.1–1.4，耐用但點火有延遲）與熱陰極的 Bayard–Alpert（10⁻² 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar，引出式到 10⁻¹²）。組合計把 Pirani 與游離計做在一起自動切換。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: No single gauge spans 1000 mbar to 10⁻¹² mbar, so a pumping station relays between three physical mechanisms: the capacitance-diaphragm gauge measures the gas force on a membrane directly, independent of gas species, each head covering about four decades with accuracy down to 0.2%; the Pirani gauge measures the heat loss of a heated wire, which depends on pressure between 10⁻⁴ and 10 mbar but reads differently for gases of different thermal conductivity and saturates toward atmosphere where conduction stops depending on pressure; ionisation gauges split into cold-cathode Penning or inverted-magnetron types (discharge current roughly ∝ p^n with n about 1.1–1.4, robust but slow to strike) and the hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge (10⁻² to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, 10⁻¹² for the extractor type). Combination gauges package a Pirani with an ionisation element and switch automatically. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：電容薄膜計：C = ε₀·A/d，薄膜面積 A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m²、間隙 d = 100 µm，C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF；滿量程 1 mbar = 100 Pa 讓中心撓度 10 µm（設計值），ΔC/C ≈ 10%；要分辨滿量程的 10⁻⁴（即 10⁻⁴ mbar），電容分辨率需達 10⁻⁵ 相對值，約 0.1 fF，這就是薄膜計必須恆溫並做零點校正的原因。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capacitance-diaphragm gauge: C = ε₀·A/d with membrane area A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m² and gap d = 100 µm gives C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF; a full-scale 1 mbar = 100 Pa deflects the centre by 10 µm (design value), so ΔC/C ≈ 10%; resolving 10⁻⁴ of full scale (10⁻⁴ mbar) demands a relative capacitance resolution of 10⁻⁵, about 0.1 fF, which is why the head is thermostated and zeroed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three gauge physics and range coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：電容薄膜計：C = ε₀·A/d，薄膜面積 A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m²、間隙 d = 100 µm，C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF；滿量程 1 mbar = 100 Pa 讓中心撓度 10 µm（設計值），ΔC/C ≈ 10%；要分辨滿量程的 10⁻⁴（即 10⁻⁴ mbar），電容分辨率需達 10⁻⁵ 相對值，約 0.1 fF，這就是薄膜計必須恆溫並做零點校正的原因。Penning 計 I = k·p^n：若實際 n = 1.2 而控制器假設 n = 1，跨三個數量級的誤差達 10^(0.2×3) ≈ 4 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capacitance-diaphragm gauge: C = ε₀·A/d with membrane area A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m² and gap d = 100 µm gives C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF; a full-scale 1 mbar = 100 Pa deflects the centre by 10 µm (design value), so ΔC/C ≈ 10%; resolving 10⁻⁴ of full scale (10⁻⁴ mbar) demands a relative capacitance resolution of 10⁻⁵, about 0.1 fF, which is why the head is thermostated and zeroed. Penning gauge I = k·p^n: if the true n = 1.2 while the controller assumes n = 1, the error across three decades reaches 10^(0.2×3) ≈ 4 times. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽氣過程中把各真空計在重疊量程內互相核對：10⁻³ 到 1 mbar 比較薄膜計與 Pirani（對氬、氦要套用 Pirani 的氣體係數），10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ mbar 比較 Pirani 與 Penning 或 BA 計；Penning 比其他計晚幾秒點火是正常的；把所有讀值對時間作圖，重疊區內偏差超過 30% 的真空計送校正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar; a Penning striking a few seconds after the others is normal; plot every reading against time, and send any gauge that deviates more than 30% in an overlap for calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three gauge physics and range coverage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 抽氣過程中把各真空計在重疊量程內互相核對：10⁻³ 到 1 mbar 比較薄膜計與 Pirani（對氬、氦要套用 Pirani 的氣體係數），10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ mbar 比較 Pirani 與 Penning 或 BA 計；Penning 比其他計晚幾秒點火是正常的；把所有讀值對時間作圖，重疊區內偏差超過 30% 的真空計送校正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar; a Penning striking a few seconds after the others is normal; plot every reading against time, and send any gauge that deviates more than 30% in an overlap for calibration. steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 Pirani 判斷何時啟動渦輪泵，但腔內是富氦氣體：Pirani 顯示 10⁻² mbar、實際是 10⁻¹ mbar，渦輪泵在過高壓力下升速、轉子過熱跳機；另一種是薄膜計感測頭在溫度變化後零點漂移，所有低端讀值帶著固定偏移，製程壓力因而設錯。

steps.instructionEn: The traceability chain for vacuum starts at the primary standards of national metrology institutes: static expansion covers about 10⁻⁴ to 1000 mbar and orifice-flow (dynamic expansion) about 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻² mbar; transfer standards are the spinning-rotor gauge (measuring the deceleration of a levitated steel ball in gas, about 10⁻⁶ to 1 mbar with roughly 1% uncertainty) and the capacitance-diaphragm gauge; working gauges are then calibrated by comparison in a calibration chamber. steps.title: 真空計校正與不確定度鏈：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱蒸騰：恆溫在 45 °C（318 K）的薄膜計接到 293 K 的腔體，分子流下 p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042，讀值高 4.2%，在 10⁻³ mbar 以下必須修正。BA 計的不確定度預算：靈敏度漂移 ±15%、參考計 ±2%、氣體修正 ±5%、位置與傳導率 ±5%，均方根 √(15² + 2² + 5² + 5²) ≈ ±17%；若把控制器裡的靈敏度常數留在出廠值 25 mbar⁻¹ 而老化後實際是 18 mbar⁻¹，讀值系統性偏低 28%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal transpiration: a diaphragm gauge thermostated at 45 °C (318 K) on a chamber at 293 K reads p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042 in molecular flow, 4.2% high, which must be corrected below 10⁻³ mbar. Uncertainty budget of a BA gauge: sensitivity drift ±15%, reference gauge ±2%, gas correction ±5%, position and conductance ±5%, root-sum-square √(15² + 2² + 5² + 5²) ≈ ±17%; leaving the controller's sensitivity constant at the factory 25 mbar⁻¹ when the aged gauge really has 18 mbar⁻¹ makes every reading 28% low. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子計校正：Pirani 與薄膜計在 10⁻³ 到 1 mbar，游離計在 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻³ mbar，每個數量級至少取三點檢查線性；把 BA 計量得的靈敏度寫回控制器；記錄溫度與氣體種類；建立不確定度預算表，並規定重新校正週期（例如一年或更換燈絲後）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate against the spinning-rotor gauge in the overlapping ranges: Pirani and diaphragm gauges between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar, ionisation gauges between 10⁻⁶ and 10⁻³ mbar, with at least three points per decade to check linearity; write the measured BA sensitivity back into the controller; record temperature and gas species; build the uncertainty budget table and fix the recalibration interval (for example one year or after a filament change).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「流量計與測試罩」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flow meter and test dome” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 廠商的抽速是在標準測試罩中量的：氣體經校正流量計注入、真空計裝在規定位置，S = Q/(p − p₀)。腔體得到的有效抽速一定比銘牌低，因為要串聯管路與閥門的傳導率。泵還有流量上限：高流量時黏滯摩擦加熱轉子，馬達電流與轉子溫度達到上限後泵會降速，所以製程氣體負載必須查泵的 S(p) 曲線與最大流量規格。氣體負載由製程進氣、出氣與漏氣構成，三者相加後除以有效抽速才是工作壓力，而真空計的擺放若直視泵口會因分子束流效應讀得偏低。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「流量計與測試罩」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vendor's pumping speed is measured in a standard test dome: gas is admitted through a calibrated flow meter, the gauge sits at a prescribed position, and S = Q/(p − p₀). The effective speed at the chamber is always below nameplate because line and valve conductances are in series. The pump also has a throughput limit: at high flow viscous friction heats the rotor, and once motor current and rotor temperature reach their limits the pump slows, so process gas loads must be checked against the pump's S(p) curve and its maximum-throughput rating. The gas load is the sum of process gas, outgassing and leaks, and that sum divided by the effective speed is the working pressure; a gauge that looks straight into the pump inlet reads low because of molecular beaming. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Flow meter and test dome”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。經 DN100、30 cm 的管子（C ≈ 403 L/s）接到腔體：S_eff = 1/(1/287 + 1/403) ≈ 168 L/s。若泵的最大流量為 2 mbar·L/s（教學假設），對應的入口壓力為 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar，製程壓力若高於此值，泵會降速或過熱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen. Through a DN100 tube 30 cm long (C ≈ 403 L/s) to the chamber: S_eff = 1/(1/287 + 1/403) ≈ 168 L/s. If the pump's maximum throughput is 2 mbar·L/s (teaching assumption), the corresponding inlet pressure is 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar, and a process pressure above that slows or overheats the pump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速；真空計要裝在不直視泵口的位置；把結果與廠商的 S(p) 曲線比較；在最大流量下連續運轉一小時，記錄馬達功率與轉子溫度是否穩定在上限以內；流量計用什麼氣體，抽速就是對什麼氣體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed; mount the gauge out of the pump's line of sight; compare with the vendor's S(p) curve; run one hour at maximum throughput and record whether motor power and rotor temperature settle below their limits; the speed measured is for the gas used in the flow meter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵站的整合是一連串有條件的動作：先啟動前級泵，前級壓力低於渦輪泵允許的啟動壓力後才升速；升速需數分鐘，控制器監看轉速、電流與溫度；真空計在 10⁻³ mbar 附近由 Pirani 切換到游離計；渦輪泵轉速超過 90% 且腔體已經由旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar 以下，閘閥才允許開啟。停電時通氣閥在延遲後以乾燥氮氣通氣，讓轉子受控減速並阻止前級的油氣或微粒回流；通氣速率要受限，避免黏滯氣流對葉片造成衝擊。冷卻（風冷或水冷）、入口法蘭的烘烤溫度上限（約 120 °C）、外部磁場（渦電流加熱轉子）與振動去耦都要在整合時一併設定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrating a pumping station is a chain of conditional actions: start the backing pump first and run the turbopump up only once the foreline is below its permitted start pressure; run-up takes minutes while the controller watches speed, current and temperature; gauges switch from Pirani to ionisation near 10⁻³ mbar; the gate valve may open only when the turbopump exceeds 90% speed and the chamber has been rough-pumped through a bypass below 10⁻² mbar. On a power failure the vent valve admits dry nitrogen after a delay so the rotor decelerates under control and no oil vapour or particles backstream from the foreline; the venting rate is throttled so that viscous inflow does not shock the blades. Cooling (air or water), the inlet-flange bake limit (about 120 °C), external magnetic fields (eddy-current heating of the rotor) and vibration decoupling are all settled during integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Controller, vent valve and interlocks”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Controller, vent valve and interlocks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。在基礎壓力下不通氣自然減速，只靠約 5 W 的軸承摩擦耗能，需要 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 小時；受控通氣可在約一分鐘內停機。閘閥風險：100 L 腔體在 1 mbar 時含 100 mbar·L 氣體，若最大流量 2 mbar·L/s，開閥瞬間相當於 50 秒的滿載衝擊，所以必須先旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar（只剩 1 mbar·L）再開閘閥。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes. Free run-down at base pressure without venting dissipates only about 5 W in bearing friction, taking 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 hours, whereas controlled venting stops the rotor in about a minute. Gate-valve risk: a 100 L chamber at 1 mbar holds 100 mbar·L of gas, and with a maximum throughput of 2 mbar·L/s opening the valve is a 50-second full-load shock, so the chamber must first be rough-pumped through the bypass to 10⁻² mbar (only 1 mbar·L) before the gate valve opens. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制器、通氣閥與互鎖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Controller, vent valve and interlocks” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。維護週期依軸承型式而定：油脂潤滑的混合軸承依運轉時數定期更換，磁浮泵沒有軸承保養但要監看落地軸承次數；前級渦卷泵的尖端密封與隔膜泵的膜片有各自的壽命；BA 計燈絲與 Penning 計的放電污染也要排程處理。交接文件必須記錄泵的序號、累計時數、軸承保養日期、各真空計的校正日期與靈敏度常數、互鎖邏輯版本與備品清單。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records. Maintenance intervals depend on the bearing type: grease-lubricated hybrid bearings are replaced on running hours, magnetically levitated pumps need no bearing service but their touchdown count is monitored; scroll-pump tip seals and diaphragm-pump membranes have their own lives; BA filaments and Penning discharge contamination are scheduled as well. The handoff record must list pump serial numbers, accumulated hours, bearing service dates, every gauge's calibration date and sensitivity constant, the interlock logic version and the spares list. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pump-station acceptance report and run log”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pump-station acceptance report and run log”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。真空計重校正週期：BA 計靈敏度每年漂移約 −5%（教學假設），允許誤差 ±10%，兩年後達 −10%，因此校正週期訂為最長兩年。維護排程：混合軸承每 3 年或依廠商時數更換，渦卷泵尖端密封每年檢查。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable. Gauge recalibration interval: BA sensitivity drifts about −5% per year (teaching assumption) against a ±10% allowance, reaching −10% after two years, so the interval is set at two years maximum. Maintenance schedule: hybrid bearings every 3 years or per the vendor's hour count, scroll-pump tip seals inspected yearly. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pump-station acceptance report and run log” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須記錄泵的序號、累計時數、軸承保養日期、各真空計的校正日期與靈敏度常數、互鎖邏輯版本與備品清單。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must list pump serial numbers, accumulated hours, bearing service dates, every gauge's calibration date and sensitivity constant, the interlock logic version and the spares list.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
